title: BrainFunctions
description:
The brain's function table (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 3, D143 rulings B1/B2): the toolkit's `config/ai-functions.json` at the pinned tag, one model and effort per function, no per-repo rows. Served read-only at `GET /brain/functions`; changing it is a `brain-toolkit` commit.

The set of functions is closed: a new function is a contracts release. The explanatory member is `reason` (the demand text said `why`; the spec file uses `reason`).

model.description: A model id the gateway's `GET /ai/models` catalogue must contain; the toolkit refuses loudly if it does not, and never substitutes.

reason.description: Why this model and effort for this function.
